coverage_override.reason: The summon effect, summoned-trigger effect, and the latter effect's turn-wide Extra Deck restriction are audited separately; the final sentence only assigns HOPT limits to those effects.

effects.printed_clause: If you control a Warrior "Gaia" monster(s): You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A hand Ignition Effect checks for a face-up Warrior Gaia monster, an open Monster Zone, and this card's summon legality, then Special Summons it under the shared first HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Gaia support supplies a conditioned self-Special Summon from the hand and checks the available Monster Zone.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can banish 1 Dragon or 1 Warrior Normal Monster from your hand or GY; Special Summon 1 "Gaia the Dragon Champion" or 1 monster that mentions it from your Deck/Extra Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: The Normal/Special Summon trigger now accepts any removable Dragon, or a removable Warrior that is also Normal, from hand/GY as cost; resolution summons the exact listed Fusion or a card whose text lists it from Deck/Extra Deck.

official_references.card_name: Sky Galloping Gaia the Dragon Champion
official_references.matched_structure: Official Gaia support uses Gaia the Dragon Champion's listed identity and Dragon/Warrior support structure.
Official listed-name searches use aux.IsCodeListed to match cards whose text mentions a specific card.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the repeated article in '1 Dragon or 1 Warrior Normal Monster' makes the alternatives any Dragon, or a Warrior Normal Monster. The old grouped predicate incorrectly required Dragons to be Normal too.

effects.printed_clause: You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Level 5 or higher Dragon monsters.
effects.lua_implementation: A custom activity counter prevents activation after a disallowed Extra Deck summon, and activation installs an oath restriction through the End Phase allowing only Level 5+ Dragons from the Extra Deck.

official_references.matched_structure: Official all-turn summon restrictions combine an activity-history check with a rest-of-turn EFFECT_CANNOT_SPECIAL_SUMMON oath.
